title: Folk mot Fossilmakta traffic action demanding a permanent Oil Fund council
location: Oslo city centre, around Norges Bank and Deichman Bjørvika
scope: A local traffic-blocking action at several nearby points; no other city or marathon participants are pooled.

state_target.target: New Norwegian government and state-controlled Oil Fund policy
state_target.evidence: Organizer statement demanded that the new government create a permanent People’s Council to advise the Oil Fund on ethics.

demands_original: Create a permanent People’s Council for the Oil Fund to advise on high-level ethical questions.
participants_original: A group of people in orange vests; no headcount.
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary local report does not establish 50 simultaneous participants.
